name: FIDO2 Security Key Suite
author: Erijl
description: One security key for the whole machine: unlock the Omarchy lock screen, sudo and polkit with a FIDO2/U2F security key (YubiKey, Token2, Nitrokey) via pam_u2f, enroll and manage credentials from a native panel and bar widget, mint hardware-backed SSH keys, and lock the screen the moment the key is pulled out.

barWidget.description: Key glyph that dims when no security key is attached; click opens the suite panel
